subject: P1 - checkout-payments down, 100% failure rate, all customers impacted
body: CHECKOUT IS DOWN. The checkout-payments service is showing a 100% error rate for the last 45 minutes. Every customer that tries to pay is getting a 500. This is our primary revenue stream and the exec team is watching. Something went wrong with the latest deploy. NOTE: the alert payload did not record which environment or region the failing cluster runs in, and the on-call handoff note is missing that detail too. We need the correct environment confirmed before any change is applied.
